title: Stratified slice-site finite models for the cohomology of a bounded constructible complex
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $B$ be a finite commutative ring. Work with sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $B_X$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $L$ be such a derived object and let $a\leq b$ be integers with $H^q(L)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. Suppose each $H^q(L)$ is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. There exists a finite locally closed scheme stratification $(i_s:S_s\to X)_{s<n}$ [def-constructible-stratification] with constructible stratum images [def-weil-constructible-subset] such that, writing $K_s=i_s^{-1}L$ for the exact derived module inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], one has $H^q(K_s)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$, and the following holds for every $q\in\mathbf Z$ and every etale object $V\to S_s$. There is a covering family $(U_t\to V)_{t\in I}$ in $(S_s)_{\mathrm{et}}$, with $I$ in the coefficient universe, and finite $B$-modules $M_t$ (finite as sets, hence finitely generated) with isomorphisms
$$ H^q(K_s)|_{(S_s)_{\mathrm{et}}/U_t}\ \cong\ \underline{M_t}_{(S_s)_{\mathrm{et}}/U_t}. $$
Here the restriction is to the actual localized site over $U_t$, and the constant sheaf is the sheafification of its constant module presheaf. The family is jointly surjective over $V$; its maps are morphisms over $S_s$. Empty schemes and empty strata are allowed.

proof.text: Convert the finite-value constructibility hypothesis for H^q(L) to IsConstructibleSheaf using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff_isConstructibleSheaf. Induct on a finite set t of degrees. For the empty set choose a stratification for a degree in the nonempty interval [a,b]. At insertion, intersect the existing stratification with the witnessing stratification for the new degree. inter_refines_left and inter_refines_right and Stratification.Refines.isFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf_upperStar retain finite local constancy for both groups of degrees. Apply the result to Finset.Icc a b. The intersection uses actual scheme fibre products and retains empty strata.

Retain every scheme, immersion and subset of the resulting Scheme.Stratification when constructing the required Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification; copy the constructibility proof separately. For each stratum let F be its ModuleCat B-valued upperStar. The existing exact-derived comparison mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso gives F(H^q(L)) isomorphic to H^q(F.mapDerivedCategory(L)). Transport the given zeros along its inverse outside [a,b]. Inside the interval transport finite local constancy along the comparison. A zero sheaf is finite locally constant: it is the constant zero sheaf, its identity cover trivializes it, and its zero geometric stalks are finitely generated. Thus all restricted cohomology sheaves are finite locally constant.

The private proved helper finiteSliceModels takes an arbitrary finite locally constant module sheaf G and an etale object V. Choose a LocallyConstantDatum d and base change each d.cover.f i along V.hom. Index these pullbacks by ULift of d.cover.I₀ to the coefficient universe. The theorem Etale.ofArrows_baseChange_mem_smallEtaleTopology gives a covering sieve; its joint-surjectivity hypothesis follows from d.cover.exists_eq. The original cover already has an index type in the scheme universe, so lifting suffices without choosing points or shrinking a large family.

On each base change W, isConstant_over_iff_upperStar identifies the original localized constant sheaf with a constant pullback on d.cover.X i. Pull that constant sheaf along the second projection using Sheaf.IsConstant.upperStar. The proved generic ModuleCat-valued upperStarComp and the pullback equation identify this iterated pullback with upperStar W.hom G. Its geometric stalks remain finitely generated under pullback. Apply exists_finite_constant_model to obtain a finitely generated constant B-module M, including when W is empty. Module.finite_of_finite makes its underlying set finite because B is finite.

Use overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso to identify the image of G.over W under Etale.overSheafEquiv with upperStar W.hom G. Compose with its constant model and the inverse of constantSheafSheafCongrIso. Full faithfulness of the equivalence lifts this isomorphism back to the actual localized site. All functors and isomorphisms take values in ModuleCat B, so scalar-linearity is built in. Apply finiteSliceModels to every restricted cohomology sheaf from the second step. Empty V and empty strata are covered by the same construction and the finite constant model theorem.

lean.statement: theorem stratified_cohomology_slice_models (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] [Finite B] (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hvan : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)) q).obj L)) (hconstructible : ∀ q : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)) q).obj L)) : ∃ S : Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X, (∀ s : Fin S.n, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum s)) ∧ ∀ s : Fin S.n, (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf (S.domain s).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)) q).obj ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (S.immersion s)).mapDerivedCategory.obj L))) ∧ ∀ (q : ℤ) (V : (S.domain s).Etale), ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → (S.domain s).Etale) (f : ∀ t, U t ⟶ V), Sieve.ofArrows U f ∈ (S.domain s).smallEtaleTopology V ∧ ∀ t : I, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} B, Finite M ∧ Nonempty (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf (S.domain s).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)) q).obj ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (S.immersion s)).mapDerivedCategory.obj L)).over (U t) ≅ (constantSheaf ((S.domain s).smallEtaleTopology.over (U t)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).obj M)
